evals.prompt: DP pass on this shot list: [5 shots of a night conversation in a car under streetlights].
evals.expected_output: Per-shot lens mm, aperture/DOF, height, position, support, movement execution, and a motivated lighting setup with directions and colors.
expectations: Every shot has a focal length in mm and an aperture or DOF statement
Lighting sources are motivated (streetlights, dashboard) with direction and color temperature or named color
Camera height and position are given per shot
Matched shot-reverse-shot pairs use the same lens

evals.prompt: Which lens for a close-up that should feel claustrophobic in a tiny bathroom?
evals.expected_output: Recommends a wide focal length close to the subject with reason, notes distortion, gives visible-effect wording for generators.
expectations: A wide focal length (roughly 18-28 mm) is recommended
The reason connects lens and distance to claustrophobia

evals.prompt: The director wants a long-lens push-in but the room is only 3 meters deep.
evals.expected_output: Explains the physical constraint and proposes the closest workable alternative with its effect, as a proposal to the director.
expectations: An alternative is proposed and its effect described
The response frames it as a proposal rather than overriding the director
